objects.name: C0026
objects.description: [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026) was a campaign identified in September 2022 that included the selective distribution of [KOPILUWAK](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1075) and [QUIETCANARY](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1076) malware to previous [ANDROMEDA](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1074) malware victims in Ukraine through re-registered [ANDROMEDA](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1074) C2 domains. Several tools and tactics used during [C0026](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0026) were consistent with historic [Turla](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010) operations.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023)
